name: Year
overview: Scripture reveals that the concept of a year is divinely appointed and structured, marked by lights in the heavens to distinguish seasons, days, and years as God established (Genesis 1:14). The year is divided into months, with the first month designated as the beginning of the year for Israel (Exodus 12:2). The Bible also records the ages of the patriarchs, such as Abraham and Jacob, emphasizing the significance of years in human life and God's providential timing (Genesis 25:7; 47:9). Additionally, the year carries practical and spiritual implications, including the provision for the land to rest every seventh year (Leviticus 25:5) and the redemption of houses sold, which must occur within a full year (Leviticus 25:29). These teachings highlight God's order in time, both in creation and covenant life.
